description: This file defines the SiloConnectionMaintainer class responsible for managing silo connections, handling silo status changes, and logging exceptions within the Orleans runtime networking component.

classes.name: SiloConnectionMaintainer
classes.description: Manages silo connections, responds to silo status changes, and logs exceptions in the Orleans runtime.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Subscribes to silo status events when the component starts.

methods.name: OnStop
methods.description: Unsubscribes from silo status events when the component stops.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Registers the maintainer as a participant in the silo lifecycle at the runtime initialization stage.

methods.name: SiloStatusChangeNotification
methods.description: Handles changes in silo status, initiating connection closure if a silo becomes dead.

methods.name: CloseConnectionAsync
methods.description: Closes the connection to a specified silo, with a delay to allow pending messages to be sent, and logs exceptions if any occur.

methods.name: LogExceptionWhileClosingConnections
methods.description: Logs exceptions encountered during connection closure.
